35/S0.subgoal: Describe the role of requirement gathering in the system development life cycle.

35/S1.subgoal: Compare system-centered and user-centered design and identify usability requirements through practical examples.

35/S2.subgoal: Explain usability requirements as non-functional requirements and describe the contextual inquiry method.

35/S3.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts of usability requirement gathering and specification.
